Color Picker

Pick any color and instantly get its HEX, RGB and HSL values with click-to-copy readouts, plus auto-generated shades, tints and a random color button.

📖 How to use

  1. Use the color input or type a HEX value.
  2. Read the HEX, RGB and HSL values below.
  3. Click any readout to copy its value.
  4. Explore auto-generated shades and tints, or hit Random.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the difference between HEX, RGB and HSL?

They are three ways to describe the same color: HEX is a compact code for web use, RGB lists red/green/blue amounts, and HSL describes hue, saturation and lightness.

How are the shades and tints made?

Shades mix the color toward black and tints mix it toward white in fixed steps, giving you a matching palette instantly.

Can I paste a color code from elsewhere?

Yes — type or paste any #RRGGBB (or 3-digit) HEX value into the text field and everything updates.
